title: Weather
summary: Current weather and 3-day forecast from Open-Meteo, with optional GPS location.
description:
Shows the current temperature, feels-like, humidity and wind, plus a 3-day forecast with rain chance. Data comes from Open-Meteo (no API key needed) and refreshes every 15 minutes.

Location: uses the Cap LoRa-1262 GPS when it has a fix; otherwise a fixed place you search for in Settings.

Keys: S settings, R refresh, ESC exit. In Settings, F/X move up/down and ENTER selects.
